collection.credit: NEW EVENTS — INNER LIFE, PART IX (161-180, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)

ledger.why: the casting line (the roles carry it)

collection.description: A teen secretly loves an elder's very long stories, and today the other teens drift off and leave them there.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (friend), an elder, tells very long stories. They wander. They have a lot of fish in them. (subject)'s friends groan whenever (friend) starts one. (subject) groans too, when (subject.his/her) friends are watching. The trouble is that, secretly, (subject) loves them. Today (friend) starts a story, and the other teens drift off. (subject) is left sitting there.

choices.label: Leave with the Others, Then Come Back Later

a.name: Answer A
a.text: (subject) stays. The story is about a storm, and a lost canoe, and a very stubborn grandmother. It takes most of the afternoon. When it's done, (subject) asks a question about the grandmother, and (friend) looks at (subject.him/her) properly for the first time. "Nobody's asked me anything about her in years," (friend.he/she) says. (friend.He/She) tells (subject.him/her) another one.

b.name: Answer B
b.text: (subject) follows (subject.his/her) friends, groaning in the right places. That evening, though, (subject.he/she) wanders back to (friend)'s hut, on (subject.his/her) own, and asks how the story ended. (friend) tells (subject.him/her). Neither of them mentions the afternoon. It becomes, without anyone saying so, a thing they do.
